name: Kumakura Rouhan
source:
Name: Rohan Kumakura
Sex: Male
Age: 53 (Deceased) [spoiler]| 54 (Actual, alive as #89)[/spoiler]
Birthday: January 18
Profession: Previous Kumakura Boss.
Likes: Guns, Drugs, Money, Women, Power.
Dislikes: Betrayal, Rival gangs, Cops.
Hobbies: Politics, Investment fraud, Organ trading, Land speculation.
Skills: Torture.

Rohan used to be the previous leader of the Kumakura gang. One year ago, he committed suicide by jumping from the roof of a building. He was known for his horrific torture technique of peeling his victim's skin from toe to thigh.

[From the in-game character description]

[spoiler]In truth, Rohan lives as a parasite within the body of Falco, renamed #89. He used to be half of the Cyclops Serial Killers, co-working with Saito Sejima, before he was arrested under the "Falco" persona for breaking-and-entering.

His "suicide" was in fact Shoko Nadami as a parasite within his body.[/spoiler]
